instructions_to_main_agent: Design Identity: You are building an authoritative, premium multi-business SaaS. The tone is objective, rigid, and functional-first (Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast).
Marketing Pages: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for the public landing pages. Implement a 'Tetris' Bento grid showcasing the 4 businesses asymmetrically. Do NOT use standard Shadcn cards for marketing.
Dashboards & Portals: Use Shadcn components but override them heavily. Use `rounded-none` everywhere. Remove all soft shadows. Use strict 'Technical Look' grids (border-r border-b on grid items).
Typography: Use 'Outfit' for headings with tight letter spacing and 'Manrope' for body text. Enforce extreme contrast between headings (Large, Black weight) and body.
Colors: UI must be 95% monochrome (White, F5F5F5, 0A0A0A). Color is functional only. Use Accent (#002FA7) strictly for primary SaaS CTAs.
Dark Mode (If implemented): Do not use pure black. Use #121212 background and #1F1F1F surface. Desaturate the accent color by 20%.
Testing: Add data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based) to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, menu items, tabs).
